title: How Many Islands of Friends
statement:
There are `n` people and `m` friendships (each friendship joins two different people). Two people are in the same group if they are friends or are linked through a chain of friends. Count the groups. A person with no friends forms a group alone.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines contains two people (numbered from 1) who are friends. No friendship is listed twice.

## Output
Print the number of groups.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 15000`
- `0 <= m <= 15000`
